serialization: Field names follow the glTF 2.0 metallic-roughness model and the ratified KHR extensions for clearcoat, sheen, transmission, volume, ior and emissive strength.

filament-metals.title: Physically Based Rendering in Filament, table of normal-incidence reflectance for common metals (sRGB base colours, derived there from measured data)
filament-metals.licence: Apache-2.0 (document source in the Filament repository)

filament-reflectance.title: Physically Based Rendering in Filament, table of reflectance of common materials (attributed there to Real-Time Rendering, 4th edition): water IOR 1.33, plastics and glass IOR 1.5 to 1.58, default 1.5
filament-reflectance.licence: Apache-2.0 (document source in the Filament repository)

gltf-metallic.title: glTF 2.0 specification, metallic-roughness material: metallic 1 is a conductor (metal), metallic 0 a dielectric
gltf-metallic.licence: Khronos specification, quoted as a definition only

authored.title: Set by hand by the FormCAD authors by eye for a plausible look; no measurement behind it. Edit freely.

Stainless steel 304.note: Approximation: the base colour is that of iron, the nearest metal in the cited table; stainless steel is not in it.

Aluminium 6061.note: The aluminium row of the cited table; the alloy is not separated.

Titanium Ti-6Al-4V.note: The titanium row of the cited table; the alloy is not separated.

appearances.name: Glass, clear
